Totodile

Water

Johto · Generation 2

Totodile is a Water-type Big Jaw Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 9.5 kg. It evolves into Croconaw. Its highest base stat is Attack (65), with a base stat total of 314.
